title: ClientEventBatch
description: Body of POST /api/telemetry/events: one flush of the browser's event buffer, oldest first.

name.description: Event name, e.g. 'session.start' or 'ui.click'. It becomes a metric dimension, so its shape is bounded.

sessionId.description: One id per browser tab. A crypto.randomUUID() today, but not required to be one - tabs carry ids issued before that was true.

at.description: Wall-clock time the event was recorded, from the browser's clock.

seq.description: Monotonic per session. Orders the session regardless of the order batches arrive in.

t.description: Milliseconds since session start, so a session can be replayed at the pace the user experienced.

props.description: Event payload with at most 32 fields. Unknown names are accepted, but values must be flat scalars and strings are limited to 1024 characters. Callers must not send patient data; size limits are not redaction.
